items.title: 8.12 The effect of change of concentrations (concentration badalne ka asar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.12, printed page 180.

blocks.text: Agar system equilibrium par ho aur kisi reactant ya product ki kuch amount (miqdar) dal di jaye ya nikal di jaye, to equilibrium ki position disturb ho jati hai.
Reactants aur products ki concentration badalne ki chaar possibilities (soorten) hain.
